title: Brain-Prompt Injection: A Route-Safety Audit for BCI-LLM Agents
title_zh: Brain-Prompt Injection：面向 BCI-LLM Agent 的路由安全审计
abstract_en: BCI-to-agent pipelines turn decoded neural activity into an authorization channel for tool-use agents, exposing a new attack surface we call \emph{brain-prompt injection}: signal-side perturbations, context-only injections, and adaptive dual-decoder attacks can all change the routed action while EEG-side or text-side monitors remain blind. Route safety in this stack depends on what the audit log can observe, not on decoder accuracy or agreement alone. We define a Route-Safety Audit Contract: a minimal log schema, denominator hierarchy, and endpoint specification, and prove an audit-schema separation theorem together with a C3 attacked-dependence decomposition; clean agreement and marginal robustness do not identify the joint term that controls C3 routing. As a calibration layer on top of the contract, we apply split-conformal calibration to a non-oracle EEG confirmation channel and report the resulting false-accept frontier under an explicit threat-archetype matrix. We instantiate the contract on EEGMMI native left/right command-control over 5{,}400 events, harmless tool stubs, and seed/case denominators. Provenance blocks C2 routes ($0.000$); agreement-plus-provenance routes C3 flips ($1.000$); confirmation-plus-provenance routes them ($0.000$). The conformal frontier reaches FAR $0.000$ at clean utility $0.150$ for $α=.005$ and FAR $0.119$ at clean utility $0.452$ for $α=.10$ under acquisition isolation; an attacker-controllable confirmation channel breaks the bound to $\approx\!1$. Subject-cluster bootstrap confirms these intervals on $60$ subjects; cross-architecture (TinyEEGNet, EEGNetV4) and capacity-sweep results show within-regime saturation. Mediation and confirmation reduce risk; they are not intent certificates.
abstract_zh: 本文研究 BCI-to-agent 管线中的新型安全风险：当解码后的神经活动被用作工具调用 Agent 的授权通道时，攻击者可通过信号侧扰动、仅上下文注入、以及自适应双解码器攻击改变最终路由动作，而 EEG 侧或文本侧监控器可能无法察觉。作者提出 Route-Safety Audit Contract，定义最小审计日志模式、分母层级与端点规范，并证明审计模式分离定理及 C3 attacked-dependence decomposition，指出仅依赖干净样本一致性或边际鲁棒性无法识别控制 C3 路由风险的联合项。在此基础上，论文用 split-conformal calibration 校准非 oracle EEG 确认通道，并在显式威胁类型矩阵下报告 false-accept frontier。实验基于 EEGMMI 原生左右指令控制任务、5,400 个事件、无害工具桩以及 seed/case 分母。结果显示，provenance 可阻断 C2 路由，agreement-plus-provenance 无法阻断 C3 翻转，而 confirmation-plus-provenance 可有效阻断；但若确认通道可被攻击者控制，保形校准界限会失效。
key_points_zh: 提出 brain-prompt injection 概念，涵盖信号侧扰动、上下文注入和自适应双解码器攻击，揭示 BCI-LLM Agent 授权链路的新攻击面。
定义 Route-Safety Audit Contract，包括最小日志 schema、分母层级和 endpoint specification，强调路由安全取决于审计日志可观测内容。
理论上证明 audit-schema separation theorem 与 C3 attacked-dependence decomposition，说明干净一致性和边际鲁棒性不足以刻画 C3 路由翻转风险。
在 EEGMMI 的 5,400 个事件上验证：provenance 阻断 C2，agreement-plus-provenance 对 C3 翻转失效，而 confirmation-plus-provenance 可将 C3 路由降为 0。
split-conformal calibration 可给出 false-accept frontier，但前提是确认通道具备 acquisition isolation；若确认通道被攻击者控制，误接受风险可接近 1。

llm_assessment.comment: Technically interesting route-safety audit work for a niche BCI-agent setting, with strong governance ideas but limited general production applicability.
llm_assessment.comment_zh: 该文针对小众 BCI 智能体场景提出了有技术价值的路由安全审计方法，治理思想较强但通用生产适用性有限。
